notes: This scenario is deliberately the 'nothing crosses a threshold' case: regime/bias unchanged, confidence moved only 2 points (well under the 15-point CONFIDENCE_CHANGE_THRESHOLD), and expected_range/invalidation/major_driver are byte-identical to the previous thesis — so the transition engine correctly falls all the way through to NO_CHANGE. Per Bitmomo_Watchtower_Alert_Policy::TRANSITION_ALERT_CLASS_MAP, NO_CHANGE has no entry at all (not merely mapped to 'don't alert') so alert_class is null and should_alert is false — and per Bitmomo_Watchtower_Analyst_Router, NO_CHANGE routes to no analyst track (track: null). This is the concrete demonstration of Task 7's 'NO_CHANGE never alerts' requirement.

A real FUNDING_EXTREME event this material (score 68, material_candidate band) would still be worth surfacing SOMEWHERE even if it doesn't move the thesis enough to alert — Product B's current design has no mechanism for that ('interesting but thesis-neutral' events are simply not visible past the materiality score itself, since only a thesis-changing transition ever reaches the alert outbox or admin diagnostics screen's alert list). Flagged as a documented gap, not fixed here — see the Task 11 audit and CODEX_HANDOFF update.
